1 طَارَ حَوْلَهُ , aor. يَطُورُ, (TA,) inf. n. طَوْرٌ and طَوَرَانٌ, (K,) He went, or hovered, (حَامَ,) round about it. (K, * TA.) ―
-b2- Hence, لَا يَطُورُنِى He will not approach my immediate vicinage. (TA.) And لَا تَطُرْ حَرَانَا Approach thou not our environs. (S, O, TA.) And لَا أَطُورُ بِهِ I will not approach him, or it: (S, O, TA:) occurring in a trad. (TA.) And فُلَانٌ يَطُورُ بِفُلَانٍ Such a one as it were hovers round about such a one, and draws near to him. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
